entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There are Shadows here as well...[n]Perhaps they are protecting something.
entries.uk: Тут теж є Тіні... Можливо, вони[n]щось охороняють.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That one seems pretty tough... We'll[n]have to make sure we're good and ready.
entries.uk: Ця на вигляд доволі сильна...[n]Треба як слід підготуватися.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That one's definitely tough. Are we good[n]to go?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right. Just make sure you're fully[n]prepared before you confront it.
entries.uk: Гаразд. Тільки добре підготуйся,[n]перш ніж ставати з ним до бою.

entries.speaker: Security Shadow
entries.en: But since you're here... It'll be the last[n]of you!
